claim: In the fourth calendar quarter of 2025, Oracle's revenue came in at $15 billion.
summary: Oracle reports on a May 31 fiscal year and does not publish revenue on a calendar-quarter basis. Calendar Q4 2025 (Oct-Dec 2025) spans part of fiscal Q2 FY2026 and part of fiscal Q3 FY2026 and was not separately disclosed as a standalone $15 billion figure in any official filing or earnings release known as of the 2026-01-04 cutoff. The claimed $15 billion amount therefore cannot be verified from established reporting.

sub_claims.text: Oracle's revenue in the fourth calendar quarter of 2025 was $15 billion
sub_claims.note: No official Oracle disclosure reports revenue for the calendar quarter Oct-Dec 2025; Oracle's reporting is fiscal (Q2 FY2026 ended Nov 30, 2025 and Q3 FY2026 ended Feb 28, 2026). As of knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04 no established calendar-Q4 figure exists to confirm $15 billion.

sub_claims.text: The period referenced is the fourth calendar quarter of 2025, i.e., October 1 through December 31, 2025
sub_claims.note: Calendar Q4 definitionally is Oct-Dec, but this does not correspond to any Oracle fiscal reporting period.
